name: g1_viewer_graded
_doc: Graded-grid smoke: a small empty open-channel run with a uniform h_fine core (fine_core box) inside a geometrically graded coarse far field (graded-structured-grid change). Exercises GridMetrics generation + the metric-aware solver end-to-end headlessly (--offscreen). A building placed inside the fine_core box then resolves at h_fine while the far field stays cheap. Viewer keys are parsed by gui/sim_setup.cpp.
